niche: a Spanish home-workout subscription app placing each paid acquisition channel of its 2027 media plan in the growth policy's scale, hold or cut band, on the 12-month net revenue per euro that the plan's weekly spend on the channel buys
answer: scale Google iOS and Pinterest iOS; hold Meta iOS, Google Android and AppLovin Android; cut TikTok iOS and Snapchat iOS (2027 return per euro at the plan's weekly spend, from generator/core.py: Pinterest iOS 1.58, Google iOS 1.45; Meta iOS 1.05, Google Android 1.04, AppLovin Android 0.97; Snapchat iOS 0.62, TikTok iOS 0.55); three decisive steps on three axes, three open channels each opened by its own step, each step with a figure of its own, seven distinct wrong calls across the lattice
answer_source: task1/generator/core.py at the draw; task1/generator/figures.json once the pack is cut
analyst_test: A careful but hurried analyst trues the app's billing records up to the stores' reports month by month, prices every install postback of an iOS network at the value its installs that allowed tracking showed at the same first two days (or at the ratio the one fully named iOS channel shows), and fits installs and value per install on each week's spend; that route cuts AppLovin Android (0.71) and Google Android (0.78) and scales Meta iOS (1.84) against the golden's three holds, and files every graded figure but five outside its band.
domain_test: Each result is an acquisition-economics and lifetime-value quantity of a subscription app (what an install went on to pay in twelve months where the app's records stop at the last open, what a network's installs are worth where the attribution export names no channel, what a weekly budget buys in an auction, the return per euro at a plan's spend and what the next euro returns); swap the nouns for another field's and the store reports, the tracking prompt, the install postbacks, the campaign flights and the ad auction stop making sense.
layer1: attribution rows re-sent after an SDK retry
staff and test accounts with sandbox charges
store report rows on the stores' own day boundaries
install postbacks dated three or four days after the install
refunds in the stores' reports and the billing records
reinstalls on a second device under one account
the networks' own install counts crediting view-throughs
campaigns renamed mid-flight under one campaign id
stakeholder_role: the head of financial planning, who signs the 2027 insertion orders with the ad networks in December

world.org_type: a home-workout and yoga subscription app

driver: Each unit's band rests on what one more period of its planned outlay returns over a year, a quantity no record holds: the detailed record takes in a payment only when the payer is next seen and the payers no longer seen go on at a rate of their own, which only the complete summary's excess over the detailed record shows period by period; the units no record ties to a source sit in one pool whose outcome is known only as a whole, each source's worth a different fraction of its named units, so one fraction per source is fitted together from how the pool's outcome moves as each source's known count in it moves across places and periods; and the outlay itself is what a supplier delivered of a set amount given that period's market, so the response is read on the amount set and checked on the periods it was moved.
driver_concrete: Zancada's growth policy places a paid channel in scale, hold or cut on its 12-month net revenue per euro at the 2027 plan's weekly spend (1.20 and 0.90 the lines). A store charge reaches the billing records only at the subscriber's next open, a store subscription nobody opens is rarely cancelled (0.97 a month, against 0.88 on the web checkout, whose every charge is on file), and the records miss a tenth to 36 per cent of a channel's twelve-month revenue, most on AppLovin Android. On iOS the export names a network's install only where the user allowed tracking (about 27 per cent); the rest, bought without the signal, are worth 0.44 (Meta) to 0.90 (Google) of the named ones at the same first two days and sit among the accounts with no channel with the organic ones, each network's share of them moving with its campaign flights by market. And installs rise about one for one with a week's spend in the record while a budget buys them at an elasticity of 0.66 to 0.82, because the platform spends more of a budget in the weeks its auction is cheap.
stump: The careful but hurried route (records trued up to the stores' totals month by month, every postback at the named installs' value by first-48-hour value, the response fitted on spend) cuts AppLovin Android (0.71) and Google Android (0.78) and scales Meta iOS (1.84) against the golden's three holds; each step dropped alone flips its own channel (AppLovin Android 0.74, Meta iOS 1.73, Google Android 0.85), no step fixed alone reaches the call, and the stronger shortcuts (the unseen subscriptions carried at the cancellations the app saw or at the web checkout's continuation; the unnamed installs at the one fully named channel's ratio, at an Android look-alike's or at one ratio for every source) each flip the same channel by another figure.
results: R1 what an install bought on each Android channel in the year to 2 November 2025 paid in its first twelve months, net; R2 the same for each iOS network, over every install it bought; R3 the installs a week the plan's spend buys on each channel; R4 the 12-month net revenue per install of those installs; R5 each channel's 2027 return per euro at the plan's weekly spend and at its stretch spend; R6 what one more euro on top of the plan's weekly spend returns; R7 each channel's band
one_fact_test: the most useful sentence (each network's installs that declined the tracking prompt are worth a different fraction of its named ones, and they sit among the accounts with no channel) leaves the unnamed installs to count by cell, market and week, the organic remainder, one ratio per source to fit across market-weeks and the thin cells; alone on the reflex route it adds 12 rubric points (16 to 28) and rescues no result whole (0 of 7); the stores' sentence adds 9 and rescues R1, the budget sentence adds 9 and rescues R3 (1 of 7 each)

differentiation.mark115: mark115 forecast a deal mechanic's second response where its new level crosses a rival's, measured on the stores that moved; here no response at a rival's level decides anything: each channel's 12-month return is estimated from three records with their own blind spots (store charges the app sees only at the subscriber's next open, iOS installs the attribution export names only with tracking consent, a weekly spend the auction sets), each opening a different channel and each ruled on by a slice the plan's channels do not reach
differentiation.task1: v6 priced the installs with no channel by one ratio that makes the unattributed accounts add up and graded an unrecorded share and two totals; v7 moves the decisive rung: every network's unnamed installs are worth their own fraction of its named ones (0.44 to 0.90), fitted together across market-weeks from the campaign flights, v6's single ratio and the one fully named channel's ratio are priced shortcuts that scale Meta iOS, the unseen store subscriptions go on at a rate neither the app's own cancellations nor the web checkout's show, and each step owns a figure the prompt asks for

lineage.driver: A unit's chance of reaching a milestone is set largely by whether the provider it is attached to keeps operating, providers stop at a rate that peaks a few months into their own tenure, and the forward group was attached almost wholly to providers in their first months, so an exit curve by the unit's own tenure, which validates on closed groups, overstates how many reach the milestone.

lineage.driver: A forward total is the sum of several flows each set by its own mechanism (a step change still applying unit by unit at each unit's anniversary, a one-off shock whose excess exit rate has decayed on a cohort whose exits also run with the calendar, a size adjustment at each anniversary set by how much of its capacity each unit uses on a book whose capacity per user has drifted, a pipeline whose conversion falls with each item's age, and exits that arrive together within groups), so every trailing extrapolation and the recent pooled rates overstate the forward total, and the committed figure is the largest step a filed band, carrying the estimates' own sampling error and nothing else, meets at a stated chance.
